intro.text: A large lake near the middle of Arelon, fed by rivers from the mountains to the southwest. The Aredel River flows out of it and north into the Sea of Fjorden.

description.text: Along with the Atad Mountains and the northern coast, the lake is one of the essential elements of Aon Aon, which shows it as a dot in the middle.
It ranks among the biggest lakes on the continent.
